messages.subject: No statET perspective despite installation.
messages.body_plain:
Hey!

I'm new to Eclipse, statET and R, so I shall try and explain my issue in as
much detail as possible from my end.

These are the versions of R, Eclipse and StatET that I use:
R - 3.2.1
Eclipse - 4.4.1
StatET - 3.4.2

I've followed the Longhow Lam guide to go about installing the statET
plug-in. Everything worked out fine till I reached the part about opening
up a statET perspective. There's simply no StatET folder/option for me to
choose.
When I click on "Help > About Eclipse > Installation Details", I do see a
StatET plug-in, but I don't see it anywhere else, be it while opening a new
project or just opening and making the StatET perspective the default one.
There's a Cheat Sheet as well, but that's the last where I see any mention
of the plug-in.

Everything seems to be up to date and I can't figure out why this is
happening. What can I do to get this running?
If there's anything that I might have missed out on mentioning, do let me
know!

Much thanks in advance.

Nikhil

messages.subject: Re: No statET perspective despite installation.
messages.body_plain:
Hi Nikhil,

did you already check the Java version used to run Eclipse? You can 
check it in the Installation Details (Configuration, 'java.version') in 
Eclipse too. StatET 3.4 requires Java 7 (1.7).

Regards,
Stephan

messages.subject: Keyboard shortcut for Next/Prev R Graphics page
messages.subject_clean: Keyboard shortcut for Next/Prev R Graphics page
messages.body_plain:
When multiple R Graphics pages are open, is there a keyboard shortcut for
next/previous graphics page view?  

Alt-F7 kind of does what I want, but it creates a drop down of all open R
Graphics pages, with the top item selected, and I have to scroll down the
list to the window I want.  

What I would like is to be hit something like "Next Page" or "Prev Page" and
have Architect move up or down one relative to whatever page is currently
viewable.

I'm using Architect 0.97 on Windows 7.

Thanks.
Triq

messages.subject: Help: console not running on debug mode on Eclipse Mars/StatET 3.4.2
messages.subject_clean: Help: console not running on debug mode on Eclipse Mars/StatET 3.4.2
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I'm trying to debug R scripts using eclipse/StatET. I installed StatET 3.4.2 on Eclipse Mars 4.5 and set up things following the instructions from:
a) http://www.quantlego.com/howto/eclipse-as-ide-for-r/b) http://www.walware.de/ehelp/docs/de.walware.statet.r.doc/reference/r_console-launch.xhtml

That included setting up a new Eclipse Run/Debug configuration as described there. Running a R script works fine, but when trying to debug I get the following error:
  "R Console launch type 'local.rterm' is not available"
I've been Googling around but haven't been able to figure what this might be. I'd appreciate any help.
Thanks,Francisco

messages.subject: file.edit causes statet to hang
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I'm using StaeET, and wanted to get solidify to work. On trying to execute
'author()', StatET hangs after displaying the output 'Opening slide
deck...'. Delving into the code of author(), it seems the statement causing
the problem is 'file.edit()'. Is there an easy way around this?

Thanks for your feedback.

Edward

--
